card.name: Chemical formula and enzyme code pieces
card.fires_on: Pieces inside chemical-sounding strings: the decimal in a molecular weight (MW= 442.24), the D in CYP 2D6, and parts of MUTAGENESIS. Also the word molecules or molecular in chemistry talk.
